rules.message: Browser code must use HTTP APIs and portable shared contracts.
Shared analysis must run in both Node and the browser.
Shared analysis must not depend on terminal or agent process code.

steps.title: Start with the contract
steps.instruction: Identify the portable data shape. Keep browser and server dependencies outside shared analysis.

steps.title: Follow repository analysis
steps.instruction: Trace walking, parsing and import resolution. Check source limits, skip reasons and cancellation.

steps.title: Connect the server boundary
steps.instruction: Inspect authentication, origin checks, repository capabilities and explicit body limits before adding an endpoint.

steps.title: Wire the user workflow
steps.instruction: Use the current shared state and view lifecycle. Preserve focus, cancellation, source freshness and accessibility.

steps.title: Verify source and the installable package
steps.instruction: Exercise a realistic repository fixture, run the full check, and verify the packaged CLI. Keep live-provider verification distinct from controlled fixtures.
